song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: So of the free one, discerning by his own power,
makings and unmakings rest in his own self, standing as his nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ

verses.craft: Durative standing (saṃsthitāḥ durative per UNC); change self-abiding — śama first landing.
verses.rejected: (a) stood-not-made gloss → killed: L3 standing-as-nature frozen. (b) heightening → killed: peace, not climax.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śānta of abiding / L2+L3 voice
